correctness.rationale: For every integer \(N\ge3\), \(p>0\), \(a>-p\), the N-state relative chain is exactly reversible with conductances \((w,w,p,\ldots,p)\) and uniform law. An explicitly solved finite Poisson equation gives total count variance \(2(p+a/N)+2E_N\); periodic harmonic lifting gives difference-count variance \(2N/R_N\). Their difference divided by four yields C_N. Arithmetic–harmonic comparison proves strict positivity exactly for \(a\ne0\); direct limits give \(a^2/(6p)\). Uniform stationary coupling and uniform Poisson moment domination give finite-time independent Poisson limits. The independent full physical \(N^2\)-chain and relative-chain exact rational verifier passed 60 cases; these only cross-check the written all-size proof.

value.rationale: Cross correlations of time-integrated particle currents are natural transport-noise quantities not fixed by product stationary measures. This minimal interacting two-lane sector exhibits a nonzero exact \(a^2/(6p)\) long-time covariance when encounter density vanishes, with a rigorous reversal of two natural limits. The theorem covers all ring sizes and admissible symmetric couplings and has structural conductance interpretation, rather than an arbitrary fixed numerical example.
